runtime_amendment.scope: Runtime and secondary evaluation budget amendment only. Original controller/evaluator algorithms, verifiers, seed partitions, primary fresh tests and improvement criteria unchanged.

runtime_reservation_reconciliation.reason: Measured completed parent input took1425.90seconds. A40minute same-worker pair could time out. Amend paired runtime before any optimizer update.
runtime_reservation_reconciliation.bound_evidence: Two terminated one-CPU inputs enqueued19:06:25UTC; app-stop log19:08:47UTC. Four minutes per input includes queue, runtime and a cancellation margin. Both inputs logged only the initial walk/alarm branch at attempt2. No branch or teacher archive exists. Main prefixes and the two unfinished branch attempts are charged, without success labels.
runtime_reservation_reconciliation.scope: Refund unused reservations only. Retain completed evidence and charge interrupted-input bounds. Keep all65927 inference tokens including two unfinished input caps. No budget reset, repeated optimizer update or positive label from interrupted data.

scope: Tinker updates six-domain Qwen3.5-4B LoRA controller-selection weights. Native ONNX weights remain fixed. All checkpoints and controls share the frozen laptop force/pulse library and measured swing-clearance option. Root/feet move only through forces and contacts. Fresh tests are uninterrupted from reset; previous 103xxx cases are training/regression evidence.

scene.book_collision_scope: Fixed, nonsliding book terrain; visual meshes and collision envelopes share the same placements. No root motion is authored.

steps.definition: Measured unload, at least 30 ms and 2 mm sole motion or 8 degree rotation, followed by loaded touchdown with 40 ms dwell. Unfinished attempts retained.

direction_metrics.scope: Travel velocity averaged over one miniature gait cycle; turning and low-speed balance excluded. Raw rendered motion is unfiltered.

native_smoothness.scope: Only adjacent samples inside native walking and turning, excluding holds and book-controller phases.

flat_foot_clearance.definition: Lowest physical collision-pad point above the local surface, with the other foot loaded. Same sensor and detector for every policy.

after_descent_clearance.scope: Descriptive first-leg diagnostic added for the post-descent walking question; not a checkpoint-selection or joint-goal criterion. Partial legs remain labelled incomplete.
